content:wysiwyg_basic:4:14.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:4:14.html:
Angel Tree: Angel Tree is a program designed to help provide Christmas assistance to children ages birth to 12.

Online Registration Opens in September.

Upon completion and approval of the application, families will be emailed their toy distribution appointment time. Families must come at their appointed time or forfeit all items. Additionally, Those applying with other agencies will be removed from The Salvation Army’s registration.

content:wysiwyg_basic:6:11.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:6:11.html:
Information Required:

Information required to register a child 12-years of age or younger for the Angel Tree:

Parent or legal guardians photo ID
Proof of current address (utility bill, lease, etc.)
Proof of all household income (including food stamps)
Birth certificate or Medicaid card for 12 and under

Clothing/shoe Sizes and toy suggestions (not to exceed $50.00)

Information required to register a senior 65 years of age or older:

Photo ID
Proof of current address (utility bill, lease, etc.)
Proof of all household income (including food stamps)

For Questions:
Please call (504) 899-4569

content:wysiwyg_basic:9:19.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:9:19.html:
Help Spread Holiday Cheer!

The Salvation Army Needs volunteers throughout the Christmas Season. Volunteers must be 18 years of age or above unless accompanied by a parent or guardian.

This is also a great way for students to complete their service hours for school!

Volunteer opportunities include:

Adopting angels: this is an indoor volunteer opportunity to register donors who adopt an angel from our Angel Tree. Volunteers also collect toys and other gift donations for adopted angels.

Red Kettle Bell Ringer: the iconic sound of a bell ringing indicates a Salvation Army Red Kettle is nearby. Volunteers are needed daily to have fun, enjoy the season and ring a bell for Red Kettle donations. The funds are used to help purchase gifts for those in our community and to meet other needs.

Toy and gift preparation and distribution: donations for all our angles need to be packaged and prepared for distribution to the hundreds of families who will be able to enjoy a brighter Christmas. Volunteers are needed to help package and distribute gifts and toys (all tasks are done at one location)

Beginning in November, if you wish to help by volunteering, you can pick a location and time to help by going to our Volunteer Portal or emailing marion.durham@uss.salvationarmy.org
